messages:
anya: Draft for changelog 0.12.1 is up — it includes Adaptive Routing (beta) and a small fixpack for batching behavior. Please review snippets, migration guide notes, and the known-issues section. Preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/changelog/0.12.1-preview
kevin: 👍 I'll update the Node/Python SDK snippets. Should we show the new routing_policy param in the quickstart example?
maria: I can add a migration subsection covering 'pinning model variants' and 'fallback behavior'. Need the exact API fields for routing_policy to write examples.
kevin: Proposed Node snippet below — feel free to tweak:
```js
// Node quickstart snippet for routing_policy
const res = await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-adaptive-1',
  prompt: 'Summarize the following...',
  routing_policy: { preference: 'latency', fallback: 'cost' }
});
```
maria: That looks good. Add a short note that fallback selection can affect token accounting and latency distribution. Also include a K/V cache note for long-context use.
samir: Reproduced a prompt truncation edge with reranker=true on >12k tokens. Filed a minimal test case: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/427 — appears to be related to chunking + KV restore.
anya: Perfect — assign the docs PR to Maria and SDK PRs to Kevin. Also we had a couple of anchor drift regressions last release; can someone sweep anchors in the migration guide before merge?
docs-bot: Reminder: docs PR template requires a 'changelog' label and a short release-notes snippet in docs/release-notes/ (max 2 bullets).
kevin: I'll open the SDK PR after CI passes, ETA EOD today. Will include both Node and Python snippets.
maria: Drafting the migration guide now; will ping @kevin when the snippets land so I can embed them. Planning to call out: (1) how to pin variants, (2) fallback semantics, (3) known issue about reranker truncation.
deploy-bot: changelog page preview rendered: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/changelog/0.12.1-preview — render succeeded :shipit:
kevin: Quick note — for Python snippet prefer this shape (keeps parity with Node):
```py
# Python
res = client.generate(
  model='redwood-adaptive-1',
  prompt='Summarize...',
  routing_policy={'preference': 'latency', 'fallback': 'cost'}
)
```
samir: Also add a known issue bullet about quota math with burst capacity: short bursts may show slightly higher per-token estimates in the console until aggregation stabilizes.
anya: Good catch. Ok team — final checklist: Kevin -> SDK PR + tests; Maria -> migration guide + anchor sweep; Samir -> regression test + GH issue link; I will merge changelog once PRs are green. If no blockers, target merge tomorrow before noon. :calendar:
kevin: On it.
maria: Draft PR up in ~2 hours.
samir: I'll attach the minimal repro to the GH issue and link it in the known-issues.
anya: Thanks all — tagging for follow-up @kevin @maria @samir
